zh: 长度为 2h 的子串前后两半相同，等价于 h 对“相距 h 的字符”每一对都能变成同一个字母；各对之间不共享位置，所以问号可以各自独立地填。
一对字符相容，当且仅当它们相等或至少一个是问号。对固定的 h，只要找到连续 h 对相容的字符就成立。
h 从 n/2 递减到 1：扫描 i=0..n−h−1，若 s[i] 与 s[i+h] 相容则 run 加一，否则清零；run 达到 h 就输出 2h；都不行就输出 0。n≤5000，O(n²) 足够。
en: The two halves of a length-2h substring match exactly when each of the h pairs of characters at distance h can become the same letter; the pairs share no positions, so question marks are filled independently.
A pair is compatible when its characters are equal or at least one is a question mark. For a fixed h, it suffices to find h consecutive compatible pairs.

Let h go from n/2 down to 1: scan i=0..n−h−1, increasing run when s[i] and s[i+h] are compatible and resetting it otherwise; once run reaches h, print 2h. If nothing works, print 0. With n≤5000, O(n²) is fine.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate the half length h from large to small and scan the character pairs at distance h, checking whether they are equal or contain a question mark; h consecutive compatible pairs give the answer 2h.

## Proof of correctness

The two halves of a substring of length 2h correspond to h character pairs that share no positions. Each pair is compatible exactly when it can independently be replaced by the same letter, so all h pairs being compatible is equivalent to the substring having a valid replacement. Scanning runs of consecutive compatible pairs checks every start, and the first solution found with h in decreasing order is the longest.

## Complexity

O(n²) time and O(1) extra space.
